name: Ras like without CAAX 1

function.text: RIT1 encodes GTP-binding protein Rit1. Annotated molecular activities include GTPase activity and G protein activity. It participates in signal transduction and Ras protein signal transduction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Noonan syndrome (autosomal dominant); Noonan syndrome 8 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Lung adenocarcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
